item.title: The Mastery Of Anthony Jeselnik
item.description: A little over a week ago, I went to The Improv to see Nikki Glaser, and unbeknownst to me, one of the other comedians on the bill was Anthony Jeselnik. I had never seen him before, and he was outstanding. His type of comedy is almost like Rod Serling's The Twilight Zone, in that each tale he tells has a twist ending that turns the story on its head. It's brilliant. Let's end the week with laughter. Open thread. read more
